entries.coverage: Four regressions cover expanding redactions, per-body and total limits, exact retained size and rejected-body budget accounting.
entries.scope: Scope: retained text bytes. Existing raw-input prechecks remain in place; temporary redaction allocations are not bounded by this change.

entries.title: Create atomic-write temporary files exclusively
entries.zh: 独占创建原子写入的临时文件
entries.change: Reserve temporary files exclusively with bounded collision retries, and only clean up a file reserved by the current write.
entries.coverage: One filesystem regression covers existing files, Unix symlinks, private and inherited permissions, exhausted retries and cleanup after rename failure.
